notes:
Implemented gh.avisingh599/roboverse as a GymnasiumDriver over roboverse.envs.widow250:Widow250Env (the first card entry symbol; roboverse.make and Widow250MultiObjectEnv were confirmed but are the factory and a subclass, not separately wrapped). The fake backend is a pure-Python kinematic stand-in, because package code may never import or run the read-only clone and the gate environment has no gym, numpy or pybullet. This differs from the card's mock_strategy.preferred upstream-sim: the sim backend is not listed in backends and was not run. The bridge accepts the upstream legacy Gym interface: reset() without seed and the four-value step (observation, reward, done, info), with done mapped to terminated and truncation never set (roboverse/envs/widow250.py:182-192 and :272-275). NOT COVERED: the upstream PyBullet rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, gravity, inverse kinematics, tray, table and camera; the fake moves the end effector kinematically, tracks the abc angle only, and models only the target object. The real observation image is a flat 48x48x3 float32 vector of 6912 values (roboverse/envs/widow250.py:339-341); the fake returns a 12-value stand-in, and the real size is named in the fidelity gaps and here. The device is simulated R0 (world.sim) with no hardware backend, no operator-required limit and no site-limits overlay; the only action bound is the Box(-1, 1) action space derived by the bridge from roboverse/envs/widow250.py:331-335. The four G8.NO_UNIT warnings (ticks, action.values, seed on reset and seed on seed) and G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 are the expected Gymnasium-family warnings (PLAYBOOK.md section 8, 'Expected warnings'). No hardware was attached or run, no native upstream environment was compared with the fake, and this model-authored package is unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by null).
